parameters.name: CheckGroupId
parameters.description: The device group ID to check. The response indicates whether the device belongs to this group.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The device name query condition. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
Enterprise instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- For new public instances or Enterprise Edition instances, Enterprise instance has an ID value. You must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- For legacy public instances, Enterprise instance has no ID value. You do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: LicenseStatusList
parameters.description:
The License status query condition.

- **NORMAL**: Normal.
- **EXPIRE**: Expired.
- **EXPIRING**: About to expire.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
